text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them organized and reliable. To get information from these tables, you write queries, which are requests that tell the database what you need. Good data modeling helps you plan how tables connect before you build them. Indexes are also important because they make queries much faster, especially when working with large amounts of data. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and suit different needs. Choosing the right type depends on your project.
